item.title: SHOW SINGLE TABLES
item.description: Description The SHOW SINGLE TABLES syntax is used to query single tables for specified database. Syntax Grammar Railroad diagram ShowSingleTables ::= 'SHOW' 'SINGLE' 'TABLES' ('FROM' databaseName)? showLike? showLike ::= 'LIKE' likePattern likePattern ::= string databaseName ::= identifier Supplement When databaseName is not specified, the default is the currently used DATABASE. If DATABASE is not used, No database selected will be prompted. Return value description Column Description table_name Single table name storage_unit_name The storage unit name where the single table is located schema_name Schema name, returned only when schema metadata exists Example Query single tables for specified database.

item.title: SHOW DEFAULT SINGLE TABLE STORAGE UNIT
item.description: Description The SHOW DEFAULT SINGLE TABLE STORAGE UNIT syntax is used to query the default single table storage unit for the specified or current database. Syntax Grammar Railroad diagram ShowDefaultSingleTableStorageUnit::= 'SHOW' 'DEFAULT' 'SINGLE' 'TABLE' 'STORAGE' 'UNIT' ('FROM' databaseName)? databaseName ::= identifier Supplement When databaseName is not specified, the default is the currently used DATABASE. If DATABASE is not used, No database selected will be prompted.

item.title: COUNT SINGLE TABLE
item.description: Description The COUNT SINGLE TABLE syntax is used to query the number of single tables for specified database. Syntax Grammar Railroad diagram CountSingleTable::= 'COUNT' 'SINGLE' 'TABLE' ('FROM' databaseName)? databaseName ::= identifier Supplement When databaseName is not specified, the default is the currently used DATABASE. If DATABASE is not used, No database selected will be prompted. Return Value Description Column Description rule_name Single rule name database The database name where the single table is located count The count of single table Example Query the number of single tables for specified database.

item.title: SHOW UNLOADED SINGLE TABLES
item.description: Description The SHOW UNLOADED SINGLE TABLES syntax is used to query unloaded single tables. Syntax Grammar Railroad diagram showUnloadedSingleTables::= 'SHOW' 'UNLOADED' 'SINGLE' 'TABLES' ('FROM' fromClause)? fromClause ::= databaseName ('STORAGE' 'UNIT' storageUnitName ('SCHEMA' schemaName)?)? | 'STORAGE' 'UNIT' storageUnitName ('SCHEMA' schemaName)? Return value description Column Description table_name Single table name storage_unit_name The storage unit name where the single table is located schema_name Schema name, returned only when schema metadata exists Example Query unloaded single tables.
